Pierre Cardin Brand Exuding elegance, this shirt is brought to you by the renowned Pierre Cardin brand, ensuring quality and style. Easy Care This shirt's button placket and easy care nature make it a practical choice for busy individuals. Summer Wear Perfect for the summer season, this lightweight shirt offers comfort and breathability in warmer weather.

aiTexts: This Pierre Cardin men's short sleeve shirt is crafted from a lightweight blend of 79.5% polyamide fiber and 20.5% spandex for breathable comfort and flexibility in summer.
Featuring a relaxed fit and solid pure color, it pairs effortlessly with various outfits for casual or business occasions.
Designed with a lapel neckline and button placket, it offers easy wear and maintenance with no ironing required.
As a product of the renowned Pierre Cardin brand, it combines elegance with practicality for everyday summer wear.

Short Sleeve Design

Versatile Color

Pierre Cardin Brand



Exuding elegance, this shirt is brought to you by the renowned Pierre Cardin brand, ensuring quality and style.






Easy Care



This shirt's button placket and easy care nature make it a practical choice for busy individuals.






Summer Wear



Perfect for the summer season, this lightweight shirt offers comfort and breathability in warmer weather.

Take care when washing and storing, as discolouration occurs easily in light.

product.desc:
MUJI Mens Washed Oxford Button Down Shirt

Prewashed to preserve cotton's natural feel. Made with organic cotton.

Product care instruction:

Colour transfer of dark-coloured products may occur during use due to friction and when handling while wet. Wash separately.

Discolouration may be caused by direct sunlight or fluorescent light.

Pieces of plant material may be woven into undyed products. As this product is not dyed colours may vary slightly between products. The product whitens gradually through washing and dry cleaning. Take care when washing and storing, as discolouration occurs easily in light.

Designed for leisure and workwear with a military brigade influence, it offers easy maintenance and durability for everyday use.
Ideal for summer activities, this shirt balances style, comfort, and practicality effortlessly.
